name: Ptahhotep
shortBio: Ancient Egyptian vizier and sage during the Fifth Dynasty, author of The Maxims of Ptahhotep, the world's earliest preserved philosophical treatise on Ma'at, moral listening, and civic righteousness.
centralQuestion: What are the universal ethical maxims that maintain truth, cosmic order, and humility in human social life?

keyWorks.title: The Maxims of Ptahhotep (Instruction of Ptahhotep)
keyWorks.description: Oldest recorded didactic philosophical treatise exploring moral listening, self-control, and cosmic balance (Ma'at).
